command_identity.classification: immutable idempotency identity, not aggregate identity

SUBMIT_ORDER.accepted_effect: persist plan only; not acknowledgement or execution

REPLACE_ORDER.targets: existing nonterminal Order and preallocates distinct replacement Order identity
REPLACE_ORDER.accepted_effect: plan venue replace; confirmation terminates original as REPLACED

closed_request_policy.numeric_encoding: canonical decimal string; float, NaN and Infinity forbidden

command_outcome_contract.acceptance_means: validated authorized durable planned effect only
pipeline: reserve idempotency identity and fingerprint atomically
dispatch only accepted external effect after all gates

idempotency_contract.identity: command_id is canonical idempotency identity; idempotency_key must equal command_id
idempotency_contract.fingerprint_input: operation_type plus every normalized closed request field except exact fingerprint_excluded_fields; command_id, idempotency_key, and causation_id included
idempotency_contract.same_identity_same_fingerprint: return byte-equivalent immutable recorded outcome with COMMAND_REPLAYED; no new transition, event fact, dispatch, or side effect
idempotency_contract.same_identity_different_fingerprint: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; no mutation or side effect
idempotency_contract.timeout_unknown: never resubmit; enter RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED and reconcile by client_order_id/venue facts
idempotency_contract.atomicity: reservation and immutable outcome precede dispatch; crash gap is recovered without a second submission
idempotency_contract.client_order_id: deterministically derived from scoped command identity, stable across retries, never caller authority
idempotency_contract.duplicate_event: same audit_event_id and canonical fingerprint is replay success/ignored
idempotency_contract.event_identity_conflict: same audit_event_id different fingerprint is EVENT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT
idempotency_contract.duplicate_ack: venue_order_id plus acknowledgement fact deduplicated; identical replay ignored
idempotency_contract.duplicate_fill: fill_id is durable canonical identity; venue_trade_id is scoped external dedupe key; identical duplicate ignored, conflicting duplicate requires reconciliation

order_lifecycle.restore_rule: RESTORE_PRE_REQUEST_STATE is exact stored ACKNOWLEDGED or PARTIALLY_FILLED state/version from request transition; never caller supplied
order_lifecycle.derived_reconciliation_rule: target is deterministically derived from trusted acknowledgement/fill/cancel/replace/expiry fact and full aggregate history
order_lifecycle.terminal_rule: terminal states have no outgoing transitions; late identical facts are replay, other facts require reconciliation/audit and never regress terminal state

fill_contract.identity: canonical fill_id prefix fill from M0.2; parent is canonical order_id

rules: exact M0.5 asset-reference value object
AMBIGUOUS and UNKNOWN forbidden
no default to base, quote, or settlement asset

instrument_binding.metadata_binding: instrument_metadata_version resolves exactly one full trusted historical Instrument record
instrument_binding.asset_semantics: resolved bound record supplies base, quote, and settlement asset references; no symbol parsing or current-version fallback
instrument_binding.trusted_context: nominal M05PrevalidatedInstrumentHistory produced only after successful canonical M0.5 trusted-history validation; raw/unvalidated mappings and caller booleans are rejected
instrument_binding.resolution_failures: missing/duplicate requested version, malformed history, or scope mismatch => TRUSTED_CONTEXT_FAILURE; no current-version fallback
instrument_binding.m0_7_responsibility: map key, requested instrument/version, ordered unique versions, identity continuity, Fill scope match, settlement namespace defense; M0.7 does not reimplement or weaken M0.5 structural validation

fee_semantics.NONE: fee_quantity must be exactly 0 and fee_asset_reference must be null
fee_semantics.CHARGE: fee_quantity must be positive and fee_asset_reference must be non-null, exact, mapping_status EXACT or EXPLICIT_ALIAS, and asset_namespace must equal Fill.exchange_id
fee_semantics.third_asset_fee: legal and preserved without base/quote default
fee_semantics.maker_rebate: unsupported fail-closed; negative decimals forbidden; a future explicit economic fact kind is required

canonicalization: exact fact field order is schema attestation; JSON object keys sorted for hashing
canonical JSON separators comma and colon

dedupe.same_external_key_same_economics: REPLAY_SUCCESS; if fill_id differs retain first fact and create zero duplicate economic effect

trusted_resolution.shape: map fill_id -> exact immutable full Fill fact
trusted_resolution.authority: composite Core-owned trusted boundary: exact Fill validation plus nominal prevalidated M0.5 instrument history binding; never caller or event safe_payload authority
rules: map key equals fact.fill_id
exact schema and fingerprint required
one deterministic fact per fill_id
missing fill is TRUSTED_CONTEXT_FAILURE, never zero execution or no-fee
conflicting duplicate is FILL_IDENTITY_CONFLICT
persistence implementation deferred to M0.11
composite resolver returns Fill only with its exact resolved historical Instrument record
raw instrument_history_by_id mapping is rejected even when shaped correctly
safe_payload fill_id resolves through trusted fills_by_id
Fill order_id equals event order_id
Fill environment workspace portfolio exchange_account exchange instrument and route equal event envelope
Fill venue_trade_id equals safe_payload venue_trade_id
Fill fingerprint validates before lifecycle effect
cumulative_executed_quantity is recomputed from accepted unique Fill history and must equal payload; caller value is not authority
all historical Fill scope fields match event envelope
cumulative uses canonical durable and scoped external venue-trade dedupe semantics
complete Core-owned accepted_fill_ids_by_order_id sequence is mandatory; no caller list and no current-fill fallback
current canonical Fill occurs in the exact Order sequence; an exact duplicate external trade outside it is REPLAY_SUCCESS

accepted_history_context.shape: nominal CoreAcceptedFillProjection: order_id -> one ordered canonical accepted fill_id sequence
accepted_history_context.authority: Core-owned projection derived from accepted M0.7 event/order history; raw mapping/list, caller request and safe_payload are rejected
accepted_history_context.duplicate_external_trade: only first canonical economic effect remains in sequence; later exact duplicate resolves to REPLAY_SUCCESS and creates no lifecycle or cumulative effect

fill_contract.cumulative_executed_quantity: sum of unique accepted full-economic Fill facts in deterministic accepted event sequence
fill_contract.remaining_quantity: order quantity minus cumulative executed quantity
fill_contract.average_execution_price: retain exact notional numerator and cumulative executed denominator; emit canonical decimal only when quotient has a finite decimal expansion; otherwise null for presentation and never apply implicit Decimal-context rounding
invariants: executed_at_utc is immutable economic time and distinct from event occurred_at_utc
fill_contract.canonical_decimal_output: M0.5 regex; fractional trailing zeros removed and zero exactly 0

trust_boundaries.raw_structural_fill: validate_fill proves exact fields, types, canonical encoding, fee scope and full-economic fingerprint only; not trusted economic authority
trust_boundaries.trusted_economic_fill: composite resolver requires structural validity plus resolution against a nominal prevalidated M0.5 instrument history context
trust_boundaries.complete_accepted_history: Core-owned accepted_fill_ids_by_order_id projection derived only from accepted M0.7 lifecycle history; caller request, safe_payload, and raw list/dict are never authority

event_contract.safe_payload: exact event_schema_registry; no unknown or missing fields and no secrets, credentials, endpoints, raw venue response, arbitrary payload or PII
event_contract.ordering: per-order aggregate_version starts at 1 and increases exactly by one after each accepted new fact
event_contract.duplicate: same audit_event_id and fingerprint returns replay success without version increment
event_contract.stale: version <= current with different event identity is STALE_EVENT
event_contract.gap: version > current + 1 is EVENT_VERSION_GAP and reconciliation required
event_contract.fingerprint: SHA-256 over canonical NFC/UTF-8 JSON of the complete immutable event envelope except exact event_fingerprint_sha256 field

failure_taxonomy.INVALID_LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION: valid request invalid for current state
failure_taxonomy.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: same scoped command identity different fingerprint
failure_taxonomy.REPLAY_SUCCESS: same identity and fingerprint; recorded result returned
failure_taxonomy.CONTRACT_INCONSISTENT: machine-contract drift/schema corruption/canonical dependency attestation corruption only
failure_taxonomy.EVENT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT: same scoped audit_event_id with a different immutable fact fingerprint; ordinary data denial
failure_taxonomy.MALFORMED_EVENT: event envelope or safe-payload shape, type, or canonical encoding failure
failure_taxonomy.EVENT_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH: well-shaped supplied event fingerprint differs from canonical full immutable fact fingerprint; ordinary data/integrity denial
failure_taxonomy.FILL_IDENTITY_CONFLICT: same durable fill_id or scoped external venue trade identity has different full-economic fact; ordinary data conflict requiring reconciliation
failure_taxonomy.MALFORMED_FILL: Fill shape/type/canonical encoding/fingerprint-input semantic failure; ordinary data denial
failure_taxonomy.FILL_PROGRESSION_CONFLICT: accepted unique Fill progression exceeds order quantity or violates quantitative invariant; reconciliation required; no mutation

environment_execution_boundary.PAPER: deterministic local adapter allowed after same lifecycle/idempotency gates; no private exchange connection
environment_execution_boundary.TESTNET: external side effects only after M0.4 capabilities, M0.5 account/instrument, M0.6 route/readiness authority and future M0.9 authorization
environment_execution_boundary.LIVE: first-class target; current edition policy-disabled upstream; future coordinated policy may authorize without changing this lifecycle
environment_execution_boundary.no_fallback: no TESTNET to LIVE, LIVE to TESTNET, implicit account, route, endpoint, credential, or venue fallback
side_effect_gate_order: M0.6 exact strategy instance/execution route/readiness authority
M0.7 atomic idempotency reservation and accepted plan

executable_reference_model.trust_boundary: immutable validator expectations plus independently fingerprinted canonical roots; not in-process security
